wildemount.power.mimicry.cost_or_limit: Listeners can contest the imitation with Insight against the kenku’s Deception.
wildemount.power.mimicry.combines: Enables spoken communication; kenku can read and write Auran and Common.
wildemount.power.mimicry.blocked_reason: The effect copies sounds and permits a stated check to detect the copy.

wildemount.power.aggressive.name: Aggressive

effect.summary: Moves toward a visible or audible enemy as a bonus action.

wildemount.power.aggressive.cost_or_limit: Must end closer to that enemy.
wildemount.power.aggressive.blocked_reason: The effect is a bounded movement toward a chosen target.

wildemount.power.primal-intuition.name: Primal Intuition

effect.summary: Grants proficiency in two chosen skills from a list.

wildemount.power.primal-intuition.cost_or_limit: Choose two from Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Perception, and Survival.
wildemount.power.primal-intuition.blocked_reason: No special capability beyond the stated proficiency.

wildemount.power.feline-agility.name: Feline Agility

effect.summary: Doubles movement speed for the rest of the turn when moving in combat.

wildemount.power.feline-agility.cost_or_limit: Cannot be used again until the character spends a turn moving 0 feet.
wildemount.power.feline-agility.blocked_reason: The effect is a time-limited movement increase.

wildemount.power.cat-s-claws.name: Cat's Claws

effect.summary: Grants a 20-foot climbing speed and claws usable for slashing unarmed strikes.

wildemount.power.cat-s-claws.combines: Claws replace ordinary unarmed-strike bludgeoning damage.
wildemount.power.cat-s-claws.blocked_reason: The effect grants a natural attack and a defined climbing speed.

wildemount.power.cat-s-talent.name: Cat's Talent

effect.summary: Grants proficiency in Perception and Stealth.

wildemount.power.cat-s-talent.blocked_reason: No special capability beyond the stated proficiency.

wildemount.power.claws.name: Claws

effect.summary: Enables slashing unarmed strikes using claws.

wildemount.power.claws.cost_or_limit: Damage is d4 plus Strength modifier.
wildemount.power.claws.blocked_reason: The effect is a natural attack with stated damage.

wildemount.power.hold-breath.name: Hold Breath

effect.summary: Allows the character to hold breath for up to an hour.

wildemount.power.hold-breath.cost_or_limit: Maximum one hour at a time.
wildemount.power.hold-breath.blocked_reason: The effect is a duration-limited physiological capacity.

wildemount.power.natural-armor.name: Natural Armor

effect.summary: The shell provides base AC 17, unaffected by Dexterity.

wildemount.power.natural-armor.cost_or_limit: Armor gives no benefit; a shield bonus still applies.
wildemount.power.natural-armor.combines: Shell Defense can further improve defense.
wildemount.power.natural-armor.blocked_reason: The effect is a fixed defensive value.

wildemount.power.shell-defense.name: Shell Defense

effect.summary: Withdraws the tortle into its shell, increasing defense and aiding Strength and Constitution saves.

wildemount.power.shell-defense.go_wrong: Reduced mobility and defenses against Dexterity saves while withdrawn.
wildemount.power.shell-defense.blocked_reason: The feature changes body configuration and imposes a distinct set of action restrictions.

wildemount.power.survival-instinct.name: Survival Instinct

effect.summary: Grants proficiency in Survival.

wildemount.power.survival-instinct.blocked_reason: No special capability beyond the stated proficiency.

wildemount.power.ageless.name: Ageless

effect.summary: Prevents aging and negates effects that would cause aging.

wildemount.power.ageless.combines: Part of the Hollow One supernatural gift.
wildemount.power.ageless.blocked_reason: The effect blocks aging, a direct lifespan protection.

wildemount.power.cling-to-life.name: Cling to Life

effect.summary: A death-save result of 16 or higher restores 1 hit point.

wildemount.power.cling-to-life.cost_or_limit: Triggered by rolling at least 16 on a death saving throw.
wildemount.power.cling-to-life.blocked_reason: This interacts with dying and recovery from death, a life-state mechanism.

wildemount.power.revenance.name: Revenance

effect.summary: The character retains its creature type but registers as undead to detection effects.

wildemount.power.revenance.cost_or_limit: Applies to spells and other effects that detect undead.
wildemount.power.revenance.combines: The creature’s actual type remains unchanged.
wildemount.power.revenance.blocked_reason: The trait alters the result of effects that detect creature types.

wildemount.power.unsettling-presence.name: Unsettling Presence

effect.summary: A visible creature within 15 feet has disadvantage on its next save within one minute.

wildemount.power.unsettling-presence.cost_or_limit: Action; once per long rest; constructs, undead, and creatures immune to fear are unaffected.
wildemount.power.unsettling-presence.mind: Imposes an unsettling influence that worsens the target’s next save.
wildemount.power.unsettling-presence.combines: Requires a visible target in range.
wildemount.power.unsettling-presence.blocked_reason: The grammar cannot represent disadvantage on a future saving throw.

wildemount.power.dunamancy.name: Dunamancy

effect.summary: An esoteric magical study that bends gravity, potential, and time.

wildemount.power.dunamancy.cost_or_limit: Its secrets are complex and historically guarded.
wildemount.power.dunamancy.who_may: Dunamancers and other students of the art
wildemount.power.dunamancy.where_from: Kryn Dynasty; later the Cerberus Assembly and others
wildemount.power.dunamancy.blocked_reason: The description provides no specific basic-grammar operation or concrete limits.

wildemount.power.manifest-echo.name: Manifest Echo

effect.summary: Creates a fragile, translucent duplicate in a visible empty space within 15 feet.

wildemount.power.manifest-echo.cost_or_limit: Bonus action; echo lasts until destroyed, dismissed, replaced, or the fighter is incapacitated; it is destroyed if over 30 feet away at turn’s end.
wildemount.power.manifest-echo.go_wrong: The echo has 1 hit point and is destroyed by the listed conditions.

wildemount.power.manifest-echo.blocked_reason: The feature creates an independent, persistent entity with its own position, movement, and destruction rules.

wildemount.power.unleash-incarnation.name: Unleash Incarnation

effect.summary: Adds one melee attack from the echo’s position whenever the fighter takes the Attack action.

wildemount.power.unleash-incarnation.cost_or_limit: Uses equal to Constitution modifier, minimum one; all uses return after a long rest.
wildemount.power.unleash-incarnation.combines: Requires the echo’s position and an Attack action.
wildemount.power.unleash-incarnation.blocked_reason: The feature adds a bounded attack with a stated recharge.

wildemount.power.echo-avatar.name: Echo Avatar

effect.summary: Transfers awareness to the echo, allowing sight and hearing through it.

wildemount.power.echo-avatar.cost_or_limit: Action; up to 10 minutes; echo can be up to 1,000 feet away; fighter is blinded and deafened.
wildemount.power.echo-avatar.go_wrong: The fighter loses ordinary sight and hearing during the effect.
wildemount.power.echo-avatar.mind: Consciousness is transferred to the echo.
wildemount.power.echo-avatar.combines: Can end the effect at any time without an action.
wildemount.power.echo-avatar.blocked_reason: The feature transfers consciousness and sensory perspective to another entity.

wildemount.power.shadow-martyr.name: Shadow Martyr

effect.summary: Teleports the echo beside an attacked ally so the triggering attack targets the echo instead.

wildemount.power.shadow-martyr.cost_or_limit: Reaction before the attack roll; once per short or long rest.
wildemount.power.shadow-martyr.go_wrong: The echo takes the attack instead of the protected creature.
wildemount.power.shadow-martyr.combines: Requires a visible target and an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.
wildemount.power.shadow-martyr.blocked_reason: The effect relocates the echo and redirects a single attack.

wildemount.power.echo-knight.name: Echo Knight

effect.summary: Uses echoes of unrealized timelines to aid the fighter in battle.

wildemount.power.echo-knight.cost_or_limit: Features unlock at the stated fighter levels and have individual limits.
wildemount.power.echo-knight.go_wrong: Echoes can be destroyed or features depleted as specified.
wildemount.power.echo-knight.mind: Some features transfer consciousness to the echo.
wildemount.power.echo-knight.combines: Dunamis and Manifest Echo, Unleash Incarnation, Echo Avatar, and Shadow Martyr.
wildemount.power.echo-knight.blocked_reason: The subclass’s signature echo is an independent persistent entity with position and destruction rules.

wildemount.power.reclaim-potential.name: Reclaim Potential

effect.summary: Gain temporary hit points when your echo is destroyed by damage.

wildemount.power.reclaim-potential.cost_or_limit: Uses equal to Constitution modifier, minimum one; regain all after a long rest; cannot gain these hit points if already holding temporary hit points.
wildemount.power.reclaim-potential.combines: Triggered by destruction of the user's echo.
wildemount.power.reclaim-potential.blocked_reason: The feature adds vitality to its user.

wildemount.power.legion-of-one.name: Legion of One

effect.summary: Create two concurrent echoes, and recover an Unleash Incarnation use when initiative is rolled if none remain.

wildemount.power.legion-of-one.cost_or_limit: A bonus action creates the echoes; creating a third destroys both previous echoes; the recovered use applies only when none remain.
wildemount.power.legion-of-one.go_wrong: Creating a third echo destroys the earlier two.
wildemount.power.legion-of-one.combines: Echoes can each serve as the position for actions normally available from an echo.

wildemount.power.chronurgy-magic.name: Chronurgy Magic

effect.summary: A wizard tradition focused on manipulating time.

wildemount.power.chronurgy-magic.combines: Includes the Chronal Shift, Temporal Awareness, Momentary Stasis, Arcane Abeyance, and Convergent Future features.
wildemount.power.chronurgy-magic.blocked_reason: The tradition describes a family of time effects rather than one executable effect.

wildemount.power.chronal-shift.name: Chronal Shift

effect.summary: Force a visible creature's recent attack, check, or save to be rerolled.

wildemount.power.chronal-shift.cost_or_limit: Two uses, restored after a long rest; reaction; target must be visible and within 30 feet.
wildemount.power.chronal-shift.combines: The second roll replaces the first, after the first result is known.
wildemount.power.chronal-shift.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not model changing a resolved die roll.

wildemount.power.temporal-awareness.name: Temporal Awareness

effect.summary: Add the wizard's Intelligence modifier to initiative rolls.

wildemount.power.temporal-awareness.blocked_reason: The effect adds a modifier to the user's own rolls.

wildemount.power.momentary-stasis.name: Momentary Stasis

effect.summary: On a failed save, trap a visible Large or smaller creature in an incapacitating field with zero speed.

wildemount.power.momentary-stasis.cost_or_limit: Uses equal to Intelligence modifier, minimum one; restored after a long rest; action; target within 60 feet; ends after the user's next turn or when the target takes damage.
wildemount.power.momentary-stasis.go_wrong: The effect fails on a successful Constitution save.
wildemount.power.momentary-stasis.blocked_reason: The effect traps a target in a magical field and incapacitates it.

wildemount.power.arcane-abeyance.name: Arcane Abeyance

effect.summary: Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead for another creature to release.

wildemount.power.arcane-abeyance.cost_or_limit: One bead per short or long rest; spell remains for one hour; bead has AC 15 and 1 hit point and is immune to poison and psychic damage; the releasing creature counts as caster for most purposes.
wildemount.power.arcane-abeyance.go_wrong: If the bead is destroyed or time expires, it vanishes and the spell is lost.

wildemount.power.arcane-abeyance.combines: Stored spell uses the wizard's spell attack bonus and save DC.
wildemount.power.arcane-abeyance.mechanism: Store a spell in an item for later release
wildemount.power.arcane-abeyance.blocked_reason: A physical bead carries a stored spell with a duration, durability, and release condition.

wildemount.power.convergent-future.name: Convergent Future

effect.summary: Replace a visible creature's roll with the minimum success result or one below it.

wildemount.power.convergent-future.cost_or_limit: Reaction; target within 60 feet; a use causes one level of exhaustion removable only by a long rest.
wildemount.power.convergent-future.combines: Can affect the user's or another visible creature's attack, check, or save.
wildemount.power.convergent-future.mechanism: Set the result of a roll
wildemount.power.convergent-future.blocked_reason: The effect chooses a result in place of a die roll.

wildemount.power.graviturgy-magic.name: Graviturgy Magic

effect.summary: Named magical discipline; no specific effect is stated here.

wildemount.power.graviturgy-magic.blocked_reason: The index names the discipline but does not describe a runnable effect.

wildemount.power.adjust-density.name: Adjust Density

effect.summary: Halve or double a visible Large or smaller object's or creature's weight.

wildemount.power.adjust-density.cost_or_limit: Action; range 30 feet; lasts up to one minute with concentration; at 10th level can target Huge or smaller creatures or objects.

wildemount.power.gravity-well.name: Gravity Well

effect.summary: Move a creature affected by the wizard's spell five feet to an unoccupied space.

wildemount.power.gravity-well.go_wrong: The feature does not move a target that meets none of those conditions.
wildemount.power.gravity-well.combines: Triggers whenever the wizard casts a spell on a creature.
wildemount.power.gravity-well.blocked_reason: The effect moves a target a specified distance.

wildemount.power.violent-attraction.name: Violent Attraction

effect.summary: Increase a visible creature's weapon hit damage or increase a creature's damage from a fall.

wildemount.power.event-horizon.name: Event Horizon

wildemount.power.event-horizon.go_wrong: A successful save halves damage and reduces, but does not stop, movement.

wildemount.power.dark-star.name: Dark Star

wildemount.power.fortune-s-favor.name: Fortune's Favor

effect.summary: Let the chosen creature reroll or choose between d20 results for a roll or an incoming attack.

wildemount.power.fortune-s-favor.mechanism: Stored luck and choice of die result
wildemount.power.fortune-s-favor.blocked_reason: The effect changes how dice are rolled and chosen.

wildemount.power.gift-of-alacrity.name: Gift of Alacrity

wildemount.power.gift-of-alacrity.who_may: Spellcasters who can learn or cast this spell
wildemount.power.gift-of-alacrity.blocked_reason: The effect adds a modifier to a target's rolls.

wildemount.power.gravity-fissure.name: Gravity Fissure

wildemount.power.gravity-sinkhole.name: Gravity Sinkhole

wildemount.power.gravity-sinkhole.cost_or_limit: Action; range 120 feet; consumes a black marble; 20-foot radius; higher slots add 1d10 damage per level above fourth.

wildemount.power.magnify-gravity.name: Magnify Gravity

effect.summary: Briefly increase gravity in a sphere, damaging creatures and slowing them while impeding object movement.

wildemount.power.magnify-gravity.cost_or_limit: Action; range 60 feet; 10-foot radius; effect lasts one round; higher slots add 1d8 damage per level above first.

wildemount.power.magnify-gravity.who_may: Spellcasters who can learn or cast this spell

wildemount.power.pulse-wave.name: Pulse Wave

wildemount.power.pulse-wave.who_may: Spellcasters who can learn or cast this spell
wildemount.power.pulse-wave.combines: Caster chooses whether the force pulls toward or pushes away.

wildemount.power.ravenous-void.name: Ravenous Void

effect.summary: Create a destructive gravitational sphere that draws in objects and creatures, damages and restrains those entering it, and hinders nearby movement.

wildemount.power.ravenous-void.cost_or_limit: Action; range 1,000 feet; concentration up to one minute; consumes a small iron nine-pointed star; 20-foot radius and effects extend 100 feet around it.

wildemount.power.ravenous-void.combines: Nearby unsecured objects are pulled toward the center; creatures save against being pulled; creatures entering or starting inside take 5d10 force damage and are restrained.
wildemount.power.ravenous-void.mechanism: Persistent gravitational hazard and forced movement

wildemount.power.reality-break.name: Reality Break

effect.summary: Throw a creature into reality-warping turmoil, preventing reactions and causing a variable effect each turn.

wildemount.power.reality-break.cost_or_limit: Action; range 60 feet; concentration up to one minute; requires a crystal prism; target can repeat a Wisdom save at each turn's end.

wildemount.power.sapping-sting.name: Sapping Sting

effect.summary: Sap one visible creature's vitality, dealing necrotic damage and knocking it prone on a failed save.

wildemount.power.sapping-sting.cost_or_limit: Action; range 30 feet; damage increases at character levels 5, 11, and 17.
wildemount.power.sapping-sting.go_wrong: A successful Constitution save avoids the effect.
wildemount.power.sapping-sting.who_may: Spellcasters who can learn or cast this spell
wildemount.power.sapping-sting.combines: Failed save causes both damage and prone condition.

wildemount.power.temporal-shunt.name: Temporal Shunt

effect.summary: On a failed save, remove a triggering creature from the present briefly, spoiling its attack or spell, then return it.

wildemount.power.consecution.name: consecution

effect.summary: Mortal life ends in death, and the soul's transition should remain undefiled; undeath perverts that transition.

wildemount.rule.natural-transition-of-de.cost_or_limit: Death is the natural end of life
wildemount.rule.natural-transition-of-de.go_wrong: Undeath violates the proper soul transition
wildemount.rule.natural-transition-of-de.blocked_reason: The rule concerns the soul's passage through death, which the basic effect grammar cannot model.

wildemount.rule.divine-shackles-weaken.name: Divine shackles weaken

effect.summary: Tharizdun's divine restraints slowly weaken and leak madness into the planes.

wildemount.rule.divine-shackles-weaken.blocked_reason: Gradual weakening of a supernatural prison is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

wildemount.rule.arms-reappear-after-a-wi.name: Arms reappear after a wielder dies

effect.summary: When an Arm's wielder dies, the weapon disappears and appears somewhere else.

wildemount.rule.arms-reappear-after-a-wi.go_wrong: The weapon is lost from its current location
wildemount.rule.arms-reappear-after-a-wi.blocked_reason: The rule makes an item's location change when its wielder dies.

wildemount.rule.hag-mother-is-bound-to-e.name: Hag Mother is bound to Exandria

effect.summary: A magical curse prevents the Hag Mother from leaving Exandria.

wildemount.rule.hag-mother-is-bound-to-e.blocked_reason: A curse that restricts a being to a world requires a containment rule.

effect.summary: Punishments double for crimes against Crownsguard, Righteous Brand soldiers, or nobles; they triple for crimes against imperial officials or Assembly associates.

wildemount.rule.theft.name: Theft

effect.summary: Theft brings three to ten days in custody, a fine of twice the stolen value, or both.

wildemount.rule.theft.cost_or_limit: Three to ten days; twice value fine
wildemount.rule.theft.combines: Official or noble victim may raise penalties
wildemount.rule.theft.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

effect.summary: Worship of an unapproved deity brings 30 days in custody and a 250 gp fine.

wildemount.rule.ownership-of-another-int.name: Ownership of another intelligent humanoid creature

effect.summary: Owning an intelligent humanoid brings six to twelve months in custody, a 1,000 gp fine, or both.

wildemount.rule.ownership-of-another-int.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

wildemount.rule.trespassing.name: Trespassing

effect.summary: Trespassing brings seven days in custody, a 100 gp fine, or both.

wildemount.rule.trespassing.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

wildemount.rule.failure-to-pay-taxes-to-.name: Failure to pay taxes to the Crown

effect.summary: Tax evasion brings 5–30 days in custody and seizure of property equal to the debt.

wildemount.rule.damage-to-private-proper.name: Damage to private property

effect.summary: Private-property damage brings five to fifteen days in custody or a fine twice the damage value.

wildemount.rule.damage-to-private-proper.cost_or_limit: Five to fifteen days or twice value fine
wildemount.rule.damage-to-private-proper.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

effect.summary: Damage brings 15–60 days in custody and a fine twice the property's value.

wildemount.rule.kidnapping.name: Kidnapping

effect.summary: Kidnapping brings thirty days in custody, a 500 gp fine, or both.

wildemount.rule.kidnapping.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

wildemount.rule.assault-with-intent-to-i.name: Assault with intent to injure

effect.summary: Assault intended to injure brings fifteen days in custody, a 250 gp fine, or both.

wildemount.rule.assault-with-intent-to-i.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

wildemount.rule.assault-with-intent-to-k.name: Assault with intent to kill

effect.summary: Assault intended to kill brings 170 days in custody, a 1,000 gp fine, or both.

wildemount.rule.assault-with-intent-to-k.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

effect.summary: Murder brings 8–15 years in custody, a 6,000 gp fine, or execution.
Treason is punished by execution.

wildemount.rule.consecution.name: Consecution

effect.summary: A bound mortal dying within 100 miles of a beacon has their soul diverted from its intended afterlife to be reborn nearby.

wildemount.rule.consecution.cost_or_limit: Requires a bound soul, death near a beacon, and a new child in the same vicinity.
wildemount.rule.consecution.mind: Past-life knowledge returns subtly in adolescence and can be recovered through guided meditation.
wildemount.rule.consecution.mechanism: Soul capture, reincarnation, and memory recovery
wildemount.rule.consecution.blocked_reason: The rule requires afterlife diversion, soul persistence, and rebirth mechanics.

wildemount.rule.anamnesis.name: Anamnesis

effect.summary: A reborn person begins recalling prior-life knowledge in adolescence and can unlock memories through guided meditation.

wildemount.rule.anamnesis.cost_or_limit: Requires maturation and meditation with a guide trained in consecution.
wildemount.rule.anamnesis.mind: Past-life memories mingle with current memories.
wildemount.rule.anamnesis.blocked_reason: It depends on identity and memories persisting across reincarnation.

wildemount.rule.achess.name: Achess

effect.summary: A person who reaches clarity may choose ritual termination near a beacon, assisted by an Umavi, to enter a new birth.

wildemount.rule.achess.cost_or_limit: Requires achess, a nearby beacon, and an assisting Umavi.
wildemount.rule.achess.mind: The participant believes they have learned what they can from their current life.
wildemount.rule.achess.who_may: A person who has reached achess
wildemount.rule.achess.blocked_reason: The ritual links death to soul capture and a later rebirth.

effect.summary: Punishments double for crimes against Aurora Watch soldiers or nobles, and triple for crimes against Den officials or Bright Queen council members.
Damage brings 12–50 days in custody and a fine twice the property's value.
Worship brings 150 days in custody or execution.

wildemount.rule.business-permits.name: Business permits

effect.summary: Businesses operating in Menagerie Coast cities beyond fifteen days need an approved, purchased permit.

wildemount.rule.business-permits.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward permission requirement.

wildemount.rule.public-worship-of-betray.name: Public worship of Betrayer Gods

effect.summary: Private practice of any religion is legal, but public worship of Betrayer Gods is forbidden.

wildemount.rule.public-worship-of-betray.combines: Violation carries the stated criminal penalty
wildemount.rule.public-worship-of-betray.blocked_reason: The rule can be applied as a legal restriction.

wildemount.rule.penalties-against-offici.name: Penalties against officials and nobles

effect.summary: Fines and punishments double for crimes against a Zhelezo official or noble, and triple for crimes against a Concord official.

wildemount.rule.penalties-against-offici.blocked_reason: This modifies a legal consequence directly.

wildemount.rule.failure-to-pay-taxes-to-.name: Failure to pay taxes to the Clovis Concord

effect.summary: Tax evasion brings three to fifteen days in custody and property seizure equal to the debt.

wildemount.rule.failure-to-pay-taxes-to-.cost_or_limit: Three to fifteen days; property up to amount owed
wildemount.rule.failure-to-pay-taxes-to-.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty and collection measure.

wildemount.rule.damage-to-concord-proper.name: Damage to concord property

effect.summary: Damage to Concord property brings thirty to sixty days in custody and a fine twice the damage value.

wildemount.rule.damage-to-concord-proper.cost_or_limit: Thirty to sixty days and twice value fine
wildemount.rule.damage-to-concord-proper.blocked_reason: The rule specifies an ordinary legal penalty.

wildemount.rule.steamcasting-process.name: Steamcasting process

effect.summary: Superheated caustic mists let brittle materials be worked like steel and give metal a prismatic sheen.

wildemount.rule.steamcasting-process.cost_or_limit: The guarded technique is mastered locally.
wildemount.rule.steamcasting-process.who_may: Gwardan smiths are known for the process.
wildemount.rule.steamcasting-process.combines: Combines metalworking with superheated caustic mists.
wildemount.rule.steamcasting-process.blocked_reason: The described material change can be represented as a transformation.

wildemount.rule.skyship-route-restrictio.name: Skyship route restriction

effect.summary: Most operating skyships remain on established routes between major cities.

wildemount.rule.skyship-route-restrictio.combines: Routes include Port Damali, Ank'Harel, Vasselheim, Emon, and Whitestone.
wildemount.rule.skyship-route-restrictio.blocked_reason: A route restriction can be represented as a movement limit.

wildemount.rule.marid-powered-steam-engi.name: Marid-powered steam engines

effect.summary: A shackled marid powered underground engines; freeing it left the engines inert.

wildemount.rule.marid-powered-steam-engi.cost_or_limit: The engines depended on the captive marid.
wildemount.rule.marid-powered-steam-engi.go_wrong: Freeing the marid stopped the machinery.
wildemount.rule.marid-powered-steam-engi.blocked_reason: The engine depends on forcibly shackling a sentient being as a continuing power source.

wildemount.rule.guild-apprenticeship-rep.name: Guild apprenticeship repayment

effect.summary: Port Zoon students pay moderate-to-high fees or promise the guild a share of future profits.

wildemount.rule.guild-apprenticeship-rep.cost_or_limit: Fees or a future-profit percentage are required.
wildemount.rule.guild-apprenticeship-rep.go_wrong: The arrangement can reinforce guild control over work and trade.

wildemount.rule.vol-antim-s-succession-r.name: Vol'antim's succession rule

effect.summary: An elder selects a successor before death; if none is named, the remaining council selects one.

wildemount.rule.vol-antim-s-succession-r.cost_or_limit: Applies to the twelve elders of the Horizon.

effect.summary: When the Horizon disagrees, its eldest member decides and the others accept the decision.

wildemount.rule.vol-antim-s-foremost-cre.name: Vol'antim's foremost creed

effect.summary: Natural life is sacred and must be protected.

wildemount.rule.vol-antim-s-foremost-cre.where_from: The community's laws and religious principles.
wildemount.rule.vol-antim-s-foremost-cre.combines: Rooted in the tenets of Melora and respect for Erathis.

wildemount.rule.enchanted-street-stones.name: Enchanted street stones

effect.summary: The city's street enchantment warms stone paths and melts frequent snow.

wildemount.rule.enchanted-street-stones.blocked_reason: The effect continuously covers pathways rather than a single target.

wildemount.rule.pride-silk-protection.name: Pride silk protection

effect.summary: Without armor, wearing a pride-silk outfit sets base AC to 11 plus Dexterity modifier.

wildemount.rule.pride-silk-protection.cost_or_limit: The benefit applies only when the wearer is not wearing armor

wildemount.rule.business-guild-requireme.name: Business guild requirement

effect.summary: Permanent businesses must join a relevant guild, pay annual fees and taxes, and obey its operating rules.

wildemount.rule.business-guild-requireme.go_wrong: Guild requirements may be manipulated to suppress competitors

wildemount.rule.dyolet-harvesting-and-ro.name: Dyolet harvesting and rot

effect.summary: A harvested dyolet remains fresh for 20 days, after which rot removes its healing property.

wildemount.rule.dyolet-harvesting-and-ro.blocked_reason: The rule requires tracking an item’s age and changing its state when its timer expires.

wildemount.rule.attalwen-inheritance.name: Attalwen inheritance

effect.summary: Children of elf-dwarf unions are either elves or dwarves, not a mixed ancestry.

wildemount.rule.attalwen-inheritance.cost_or_limit: A child belongs to one ancestry; minor physical traits may reflect the other parent.
wildemount.rule.attalwen-inheritance.blocked_reason: This is a setting rule about offspring ancestry, not a supernatural effect.

wildemount.rule.aeor-s-divine-protection.name: Aeor’s divine protections

effect.summary: Aeor’s protections were tuned to resist attacks by divine beings.

wildemount.rule.aeor-s-divine-protection.cost_or_limit: Required the combined effort of much of the pantheon to bring the city down.
wildemount.rule.aeor-s-divine-protection.go_wrong: The city was eventually crashed and destroyed.
wildemount.rule.aeor-s-divine-protection.blocked_reason: It specifies a defensive interaction against divine powers, which the basic effect grammar cannot resolve.

wildemount.rule.wildfolk-crime-penalty.name: Wildfolk crime penalty

effect.summary: Killing another Eiselcross native brings facial branding and permanent exile from every wildfolk clan.

wildemount.rule.wildfolk-crime-penalty.cost_or_limit: Applies to taking a native's life for any reason.
wildemount.rule.wildfolk-crime-penalty.go_wrong: The offender is branded and exiled.

wildemount.rule.stasis-bubbles.name: Stasis bubbles

effect.summary: Translucent force spheres preserve scenes and inhabitants in frozen moments without crash damage.

wildemount.rule.stasis-bubbles.cost_or_limit: Each bubble is a 10-foot-radius sphere and resists dispelling, breaking, or removal.
wildemount.rule.stasis-bubbles.go_wrong: If barriers drop, inhabitants might age rapidly, turn to dust, or go mad; the outcome is uncertain.
wildemount.rule.stasis-bubbles.who_may: No known means of breaking them has succeeded; proposed methods may work.
wildemount.rule.stasis-bubbles.combines: A crystal, an encoded ritual, or exalted Arms of the Betrayers may break them.
wildemount.rule.stasis-bubbles.blocked_reason: Freezing creatures and surroundings in time requires a time-stop mechanism and a containment field.

wildemount.rule.breaking-the-bubbles.name: Breaking the Bubbles

effect.summary: Suggested methods require one powdered unicorn horn and one dried fiumph tentacle for each bubble, or destroying the powering crystal or striking with exalted Arms of the Betrayers.

wildemount.rule.breaking-the-bubbles.cost_or_limit: The ritual consumes the listed components per bubble; other options require destroying the crystal or an exalted weapon attack.
wildemount.rule.breaking-the-bubbles.go_wrong: The fate of released occupants is unknown and may be catastrophic.
wildemount.rule.breaking-the-bubbles.who_may: Anyone able to perform a proposed method could potentially break a bubble.
wildemount.rule.breaking-the-bubbles.combines: Ritual components, Allowak's Sanctuary crystal, and exalted Arms of the Betrayers are possible means.
wildemount.rule.breaking-the-bubbles.blocked_reason: Breaking a stasis barrier and resolving what happens to its contents requires containment and time-state rules.

wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.name: Frigid Woe transmission and cure

effect.summary: Blue spores transmit infection after exposure and a failed save; only the manufactured antidote cures it.

wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.cost_or_limit: Symptoms take 1d4 days to appear; later speed loss checks recur every ten days.
wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.go_wrong: Infection can reduce speed to zero, causing death and an icy statue body.
wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.who_may: Any creature exposed to the spores can be infected.
wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.where_from: Aeorian disease laboratory and Eiselcross ruins
wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.combines: Antidote ends all symptoms and effects instantly.
wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.mechanism: contagion, timed progression, and specific cure
wildemount.rule.frigid-woe-transmission-.blocked_reason: The rule combines infection, delayed onset, recurring deterioration, a death threshold, and a unique cure.

wildemount.rule.mutalos-environment-chan.name: Mutalos environment changes

effect.summary: At dawn the region changes habitat; inhabitants change too, and creatures that escape may remain in Eiselcross.

wildemount.rule.mutalos-environment-chan.cost_or_limit: Occurs daily at dawn; habitat is selected from a table without repeating the current one.
wildemount.rule.mutalos-environment-chan.go_wrong: The new environment can place travelers in dangerous conditions.
wildemount.rule.mutalos-environment-chan.who_may: Everything within Mutalos may be affected; some creatures leave its borders.

wildemount.rule.mutalos-environment-chan.mechanism: scheduled area-wide habitat and creature replacement
wildemount.rule.mutalos-environment-chan.blocked_reason: The rule transforms regional terrain and inhabitants on a recurring schedule and can detach creatures from the effect.

wildemount.rule.bazzoxan-gateway.name: Bazzoxan gateway

effect.summary: A gateway links the Abyss and Exandria, allowing demonic forces to emerge.

wildemount.rule.bazzoxan-gateway.cost_or_limit: Can be resealed, according to local arcanists
wildemount.rule.bazzoxan-gateway.blocked_reason: The stated planar crossing can be represented as a world mechanism.

wildemount.rule.marking.name: Marking

wildemount.rule.marking.cost_or_limit: Applies to clan members on reaching adolescence or joining
wildemount.rule.marking.blocked_reason: The rule imposes a social limit without supernatural enforcement.

wildemount.rule.execution-beyond-the-rea.name: Execution beyond the reach of the beacons

wildemount.rule.execution-beyond-the-rea.cost_or_limit: The effect depends on being beyond the beacons' reach.
wildemount.rule.execution-beyond-the-rea.combines: Contrasts with confinement in the Dungeon of Penance.
wildemount.rule.execution-beyond-the-rea.blocked_reason: It specifies whether death permits rebirth, a soul-state mechanic outside the basic effect grammar.

wildemount.rule.earth-motes.name: Earth motes

effect.summary: Broken chunks of land hover in the air and can support creatures and modest structures.

wildemount.rule.earth-motes.cost_or_limit: Typical motes measure 1d6 × 10 feet across and hover 2d10 × 10 feet above ground.
wildemount.rule.earth-motes.who_may: Creatures and modest structures can be supported.
wildemount.rule.earth-motes.combines: Held aloft by unknown arcane forces.
wildemount.rule.earth-motes.blocked_reason: The floating terrain and its support can be represented with position effects.

wildemount.rule.electric-wind.name: Electric wind

effect.summary: The gale hinders ranged attacks and may strike creatures with lightning that causes damage.

wildemount.rule.electric-wind.cost_or_limit: A creature starting its turn in the wind has a 5 percent chance of a strike; the strike calls for a DC 15 Dexterity save and deals 4d6 lightning damage, halved on success.
wildemount.rule.electric-wind.go_wrong: A failed save causes full lightning damage.
wildemount.rule.electric-wind.who_may: Creatures in the wind and ranged attackers passing through it.
wildemount.rule.electric-wind.combines: Lightning currents are woven through the gale.
wildemount.rule.electric-wind.blocked_reason: The persistent area hazard combines an attack disadvantage with a probabilistic damaging strike.

wildemount.rule.ember-thicket.name: Ember thicket

effect.summary: The smoky, ashen grove obscures vision, impairs ranged attacks, and exhausts unprotected creatures over time.

wildemount.rule.ember-thicket.cost_or_limit: Unprotected creatures gain one exhaustion level per ten minutes; distant targets beyond normal weapon range cannot be hit with ranged attacks.
wildemount.rule.ember-thicket.who_may: Creatures inside the thicket and ranged attackers.
wildemount.rule.ember-thicket.combines: Heat, smoke, and ash create the hazard.
wildemount.rule.ember-thicket.blocked_reason: It combines area obscuration and ranged-attack restrictions with gradual exhaustion.

wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.name: Etheric rift

effect.summary: Entering or starting a turn in the rift can grant etherealness until the end of the next turn.

wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.cost_or_limit: The chance is 33 percent; the rift is lightly obscured.
wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.go_wrong: A creature may be shifted into an ethereal state unexpectedly.
wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.who_may: Creatures entering or starting a turn in the rift.
wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.where_from: An anomaly linked to the Border Ethereal.
wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.combines: Overlapping invisible paths and trenches accompany the haze.
wildemount.rule.etheric-rift.blocked_reason: Etherealness changes a creature's planar state, which the basic effect grammar cannot model.

wildemount.rule.gravity-funnel.name: Gravity funnel

effect.summary: A cylindrical area increases gravity, hinders Strength checks and long-range shots, grants resistance to force damage, and counts as difficult terrain.

wildemount.rule.gravity-funnel.cost_or_limit: Typical dimensions are 3d10 × 10 feet high and 5d10 × 10 feet in diameter.
wildemount.rule.gravity-funnel.who_may: Creatures and objects fully contained gain force-damage resistance.
wildemount.rule.gravity-funnel.combines: Gravity affects movement, checks, attacks, and damage.
wildemount.rule.gravity-funnel.blocked_reason: The zone applies several simultaneous persistent rules to creatures and objects in its area.

wildemount.rule.psychic-miasma.name: Psychic miasma

effect.summary: The vapor can cause long-term madness in living creatures and bolsters undead; immersion also increases psychic vulnerability.

wildemount.rule.psychic-miasma.cost_or_limit: A DC 15 Constitution save resists madness; those who save are immune for 24 hours. Undead gain advantage after one minute, lasting 24 hours.
wildemount.rule.psychic-miasma.go_wrong: Failed saves cause random long-term madness.
wildemount.rule.psychic-miasma.mind: Can cause madness; it strengthens undead resolve.
wildemount.rule.psychic-miasma.who_may: Creatures entering or starting turns in the mist; undead benefit after sustained exposure.
wildemount.rule.psychic-miasma.combines: Living creatures immersed in it become vulnerable to psychic damage.

wildemount.rule.rust-rain.name: Rust rain

effect.summary: The rain corrodes exposed nonmagical ferrous objects and harms unprotected creatures with acid.

wildemount.rule.rust-rain.cost_or_limit: Uncarried objects lose one cubic foot per ten minutes; worn metal gear accumulates a −1 penalty per ten minutes and is destroyed at listed thresholds; creatures take 1d4 acid damage each turn unless covered.
wildemount.rule.rust-rain.go_wrong: Metal equipment degrades and may be destroyed; creatures take acid damage.
wildemount.rule.rust-rain.who_may: Exposed nonmagical ferrous objects and uncovered creatures.
wildemount.rule.rust-rain.combines: Cover prevents object exposure and rain protection prevents creature damage.
wildemount.rule.rust-rain.mechanism: Environmental corrosion and damage over time
wildemount.rule.rust-rain.blocked_reason: The hazard tracks exposure duration and cumulative item-state degradation across an area.

wildemount.rule.toxic-fungus-colony.name: Toxic fungus colony

effect.summary: The colony poisons nearby non-plant creatures and may cause short-term madness after prolonged poisoning.

wildemount.rule.toxic-fungus-colony.cost_or_limit: Poisoned creatures have a 20 percent chance of short-term madness after one hour; the colony may glow dimly within its area and 20 feet beyond.
wildemount.rule.toxic-fungus-colony.mechanism: Area poison and conditional mental effect
wildemount.rule.toxic-fungus-colony.blocked_reason: It applies an area poison and delayed probabilistic madness to nearby creatures.

wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.name: Uncanny phenomena

effect.summary: Blightshore locations may have persistent supernatural quirks, including silence, altered light, unlucky rolls, or changed water.

wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.cost_or_limit: The effects cannot be dispelled; a d10 table supplies ten possible phenomena.
wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.go_wrong: Some outcomes impose madness or alter ordinary physical behavior.
wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.mind: Some outcomes affect dreams or cause madness.
wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.who_may: Creatures and objects in the affected area, depending on the result.
wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.where_from: Arcane fallout of the Calamity in Blightshore.
wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.combines: The phenomena vary by location and may be selected randomly.
wildemount.rule.uncanny-phenomena.blocked_reason: Several outcomes impose persistent altered laws and mental effects that cannot be represented as one basic effect.

wildemount.rule.water-turns-to-acid-here.name: Water turns to acid here

effect.summary: Water brought into the affected area becomes acid after a delay.

wildemount.rule.water-turns-to-acid-here.blocked_reason: The rule changes one substance into another after a delayed interval.

wildemount.rule.nonmagical-fire-can-t-bu.name: Nonmagical fire can't burn here

effect.summary: Ordinary fire is unable to burn within the affected area.

wildemount.rule.nonmagical-fire-can-t-bu.cost_or_limit: Applies to nonmagical fire in the location.
wildemount.rule.nonmagical-fire-can-t-bu.blocked_reason: The rule is a persistent area block on ordinary fire.

wildemount.rule.there-is-no-sound-here.name: There is no sound here

effect.summary: The affected area is permanently silent.

wildemount.rule.there-is-no-sound-here.cost_or_limit: The silence cannot be dispelled as part of the uncanny-phenomena rule.
wildemount.rule.there-is-no-sound-here.combines: Described as resembling the silence spell.
wildemount.rule.there-is-no-sound-here.blocked_reason: It applies an ongoing silence field to an area.

wildemount.rule.this-place-is-supernatur.name: This place is supernaturally unlucky

effect.summary: Attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws cannot be rerolled in the area.

wildemount.rule.this-place-is-supernatur.who_may: Creatures making the listed rolls in the area.
wildemount.rule.this-place-is-supernatur.blocked_reason: The restriction can be represented as a persistent rule preventing rerolls.

wildemount.rule.black-sap-dose-risk.name: Black Sap dose risk

effect.summary: Each black sap dose calls for a DC 15 Constitution save or causes 2d4 hours of poisoning; multiple doses accumulate.

wildemount.rule.black-sap-dose-risk.cost_or_limit: The stated save and poisoning duration apply per dose.
wildemount.rule.black-sap-dose-risk.mind: The dose also blocks charm and fear for 1d6 hours.
wildemount.rule.black-sap-dose-risk.combines: Multiple doses accumulate their poisoning effects.
wildemount.rule.black-sap-dose-risk.mechanism: Dose-triggered saving throw and cumulative condition duration.
wildemount.rule.black-sap-dose-risk.blocked_reason: The passage supplies a save, duration, and cumulative rule that can be run directly.

wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.name: Blight Ichor dose risk

effect.summary: Each dose calls for a DC 15 Constitution save or causes poisoning for 1d6 hours and confusion for one minute.

wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.cost_or_limit: Constructs and undead receive different benefits from ordinary creatures.
wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.go_wrong: Failed saves cause poisoning and confusion.
wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.mind: The dose can cause confusion and alters check performance.
wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.who_may: Creatures consuming Blight Ichor, with creature-type exceptions.
wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.combines: Its beneficial effects vary for undead and ordinary creatures.
wildemount.rule.blight-ichor-dose-risk.blocked_reason: The rule depends on creature type and a separately named spell effect.

wildemount.rule.soothsalts-dose-risk.name: Soothsalts dose risk

effect.summary: Each dose calls for a DC 15 Constitution save or causes one level of exhaustion; multiple doses accumulate.

wildemount.rule.soothsalts-dose-risk.combines: Multiple doses accumulate their exhaustion effects.
